recipes.name: Beef Mandi
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53359. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. Wash the beef and cut into large pieces. Season lightly with salt and turmeric.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. Heat ghee/oil in a large pot. Add sliced onions and sauté until light golden.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. Add garlic, green chilies, and tomato; cook until softened.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Add the mandi spice mix: coriander, cumin, black pepper, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and bay leaves.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Add beef pieces and stir on medium heat until the meat is well coated with spices.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Pour in water or beef stock. Cover and simmer until beef is tender (about 1.5–2 hours depending on cut).

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 7. Remove beef carefully and set aside. Strain and measure the broth.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 8. Add washed, soaked basmati rice to the broth (usually 1 cup rice = 1.5–2 cups liquid). Adjust seasoning and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: 9. Lower heat, cover, and cook the rice until fluffy.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: 10. Place the beef pieces over the rice and steam on low heat for 10 minutes so flavors combine.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: 11. Optional: For smoky flavor, place a small hot charcoal on foil in the pot, add 1 tsp butter/oil, immediately cover for 5 minutes. Remove coal before serving.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: 12. Fluff rice and serve beef mandi with salad or chutney.

recipes.name: Chicken Handi
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52795. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Take a large pot or wok, big enough to cook all the chicken, and heat the oil in it. Once the oil is hot, add sliced onion and fry them until deep golden brown. Then take them out on a plate and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: To the same pot, add the chopped garlic and sauté for a minute. Then add the chopped tomatoes and cook until tomatoes turn soft. This would take about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Then return the fried onion to the pot and stir. Add ginger paste and sauté well.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Now add the cumin seeds, half of the coriander seeds and chopped green chillies. Give them a quick stir.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Next goes in the spices – turmeric powder and red chilli powder. Sauté the spices well for couple of minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Add the chicken pieces to the wok, season it with salt to taste and cook the chicken covered on medium-low heat until the chicken is almost cooked through. This would take about 15 minutes. Slowly sautéing the chicken will enhance the flavor, so do not expedite this step by putting it on high heat.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: When the oil separates from the spices, add the beaten yogurt keeping the heat on lowest so that the yogurt doesn’t split. Sprinkle the remaining coriander seeds and add half of the dried fenugreek leaves. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Finally add the cream and give a final mix to combine everything well.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Sprinkle the remaining kasuri methi and garam masala and serve the chicken handi hot with naan or rotis. Enjoy!

recipes.name: Chicken Mandi
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53358. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. Clean and cut the chicken; marinate briefly with salt, turmeric and a little oil.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. Rinse and soak basmati rice 20–30 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. In a large pot, heat ghee/oil. Fry chopped onion until golden. Add minced garlic and green chillies and fry 1–2 min.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Add whole spices (cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, bay leaves) and ground spices (coriander, cumin). Stir until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Add chicken pieces, brown lightly and add enough water/chicken stock to cover. Simmer until chicken is nearly cooked.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Remove chicken; measure remaining liquid and add soaked rice. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and cook rice until almost done.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 7. Return the chicken to the rice pot on top, cover tightly and steam on low for 10–15 min so flavors meld.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 8. (Optional) For authentic smoky aroma: heat a small charcoal until red hot, place it on a small foil cup in the centre of the pot, add a tsp of butter/oil on the coal then cover immediately to trap smoke for 5–10 minutes. Remove coal.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: 9. Garnish with fried onions, chopped coriander and serve with chutney or raita.

recipes.name: Lamb Biryani
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52805. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

ingredients.name: saffron
ingredients.unit: tsp dissolved in ½ cup warm milk

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Grind the cashew, poppy seeds and cumin seeds into a smooth paste, using as little water as possible. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Deep fry the sliced onions when it is hot. Don’t overcrowd the oil. When the onions turn light brown, remove from oil and drain on paper towel. The fried onion will crisp up as it drains. Also fry the cashewnuts till golden brown. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Wash the rice and soak in water for twenty minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Meanwhile, take a big wide pan, add oil in medium heat, add the sliced onions, add the blended paste, to it add the green chillies, ginger garlic paste and garlic and fry for a minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Then add the tomatoes and sauté them well till they are cooked and not mushy.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Then to it add the red chilli powder, biryani powder, mint, coriander leaves and sauté them well.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Add the yogurt and mix well. I always move the skillet away from the heat when adding yogurt which prevents it from curdling.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Now after returning the skillet back to the stove, add the washed lamb and salt and ½ cup water and mix well. Cook for 1 hour and cook it covered in medium low heat or put it in a pressure cooker for 6 whistles. If the water is not drained totally, heat it by keeping it open.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Take another big pan, add thrice the cup of rice you use, and boil it. When it is boiling high, add the rice, salt and jeera and mix well. After 7 minutes exact or when the rice is 80% done. Switch off and drain the rice.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Now, the layering starts. To the lamb, pat and level it. Add the drained hot rice on the top of it. Garnish with fried onions, ghee, mint, coriander leaves and saffron dissolved in milk.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Cover the dish and bake in a 350f oven for 15 minutes or till the cooked but not mushy. Or cook in the stove medium heat for 12 minutes and lowest heat for 5 minutes. And switch off. Mix and serve hot!

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: Notes

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: 1. If you are cooking in oven, do make sure to cook in a big oven safe pan and cover it tight and then keep in oven for the final step.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.instruction: 2. You can skip biryani masala if you don’t have and add just garam masala (1 tsp and red chilli powder – 3 tsp instead of 1 tsp)

recipes.name: Lamb Rogan josh
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52808. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.unit: Thumb sized peeled and very fine

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Put the onions in a food processor and whizz until very finely chopped. Heat the oil in a large heavy-based pan, then fry the onion with the lid on, stirring every now and then, until it is really golden and soft. Add the garlic and ginger, then fry for 5 mins more.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Tip the curry paste, all the spices and the bay leaves into the pan, with the tomato purée. Stir well over the heat for about 30 secs, then add the meat and 300ml water. Stir to mix, turn down the heat, then add the yogurt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Cover the pan, then gently simmer for 40-60 mins until the meat is tender and the sauce nice and thick. Serve scattered with coriander, with plain basmati or pilau rice.

recipes.name: Nutty Chicken Curry
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52851. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Finely slice a quarter of the chilli, then put the rest in a food processor with the ginger, garlic, coriander stalks and one-third of the leaves. Whizz to a rough paste with a splash of water if needed.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a frying pan, then quickly brown the chicken chunks for 1 min. Stir in the paste for another min, then add the peanut butter, stock and yogurt. When the sauce is gently bubbling, cook for 10 mins until the chicken is just cooked through and sauce thickened. Stir in most of the remaining coriander, then scatter the rest on top with the chilli, if using. Eat with rice or mashed sweet potato.

recipes.name: Recheado Masala Fish
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52809. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Soak all the spices, ginger, garlic, tamarind pulp and kashmiri chilies except oil in vinegar.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Add sugar and salt.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Also add turmeric powder.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Combine all nicely and marinate for 35-40 mins.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Grind the mixture until soft and smooth. Add more vinegar if required but ensure the paste has to be thick so add vinegar accordingly. If the masala paste is thin then it would not stick to the fish.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Rinse the fish slit from the center and give some incision from the top. You could see the fish below for clarity.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Now stuff the paste into the center and into the incision. Coat the entire fish with this paste. Marinate the fish for 30 mins.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Place oil in a shallow pan, once oil is quite hot shallow fry the stuffed mackerels.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Fry until golden brown from both sides

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Serve the recheado mackerels hot with salad, lime wedges, rice and curry.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Notes

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: 1. Ensure the masala paste is thick else the result won't be good.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: 2. If you aren't able to find kashmiri chilies then use bedgi chilies or kashmiri red chili powder.

steps.title: Step 14
steps.instruction: 3. You could use white vinegar or coconut vinegar.

recipes.name: Tandoori chicken
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52806. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Mix the lemon juice with the paprika and red onions in a large shallow dish. Slash each chicken thigh three times, then turn them in the juice and set aside for 10 mins.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Mix all of the marinade ingredients together and pour over the chicken. Give everything a good mix, then cover and chill for at least 1 hr. This can be done up to a day in advance.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Heat the grill. Lift the chicken pieces onto a rack over a baking tray. Brush over a little oil and grill for 8 mins on each side or until lightly charred and completely cooked through.
